description.zh: 给自媒体人：按定位出选题、写稿、改稿，一篇稿件一键改写成 X、小红书、LinkedIn 等各平台的版本，审核后发布或排期，账号数据自动采集。
description.en: For creators: ideas from your profile, drafts and revisions, then one draft rewritten for X, LinkedIn, Xiaohongshu and other platforms, published or scheduled after review, with account data collected automatically.

intro.zh: 出选题、写稿、改写成各平台的帖子，交给我。发出去之前都会先给你审核。
intro.en: Ideas, drafts, and posts for each platform: leave them to me. Nothing goes out before you review it.

zh: 按我的定位出 8 个选题
把最新的稿件改得更口语一点
最近 30 天哪条帖子表现最好？
en: Make my latest draft more conversational
Which post did best in the last 30 days?
